fieldValues.title: Checking decision points against standing records finds the real issues, and flags too freely
fieldValues.summary: A stage that reads a group's real articles, roles and decisions wrote 89 checks over two meetings, including the issue the group's own decision had to deal with the next day; 44 of the 89 are flagged in tension and none contradicts.
evidence: Master repository 2026-11-27: 11 articles, 3 roles, 11 decisions; 47 checks on the October meeting, 42 on November
November: about 5,000 pounds of work flagged against the 3,000 pound per-job limit and the board's reserved powers
fieldValues.body: This is the owner's ask ("looking for previous decisions that were relevant to any section ... highlight where we might contradict decisions") working on real records. It needs a person's triage before anything reaches the page, and a relation that says in tension.
